title: BOSS P1 preflight evidence manifest
description: Authoritative structural contract for manifest.json. verify_preflight_bundle.py enforces this natively (stdlib only) plus: hashes, file existence, zero-byte required artifacts, bundle-escape paths, undeclared files, secret scan.

host_id.description: Hash prefix; hostname is never recorded.

search_scope.description: Roots, excluded names and caps actually used.

source_path.description: Original host path, or the fixed command/URL for runtime entries.

bundle_path.description: Relative path inside the bundle; never absolute, never containing '..'.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the artifact AS STORED in the bundle (sanitized).

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original source bytes (governed-file integrity). Null for env/secret-like/oversized files.

size_bytes.description: Size of the artifact as stored in the bundle.

source_size_bytes.description: Size of the original host file.

item_count.description: Hits/rows for index and inventory artifacts; 0 means present but empty (does not count toward coverage).
